title: Week 2 review - lab and kubectl
description: Six questions across your practice cluster, kubectl and the object model.

questions.prompt: Write the command that shows which cluster kubectl is currently pointing at.
questions.explanation: Wrong context means correct work in the wrong cluster.

questions.prompt: Write the command that generates a Pod manifest for nginx without creating it.
questions.explanation: Generate, edit, apply - the fastest safe loop under time pressure.

questions.prompt: Which command explains a field you cannot remember?
questions.explanation: `kubectl explain pod.spec.containers` walks the schema without leaving the terminal.

questions.prompt: Which fields appear on essentially every object? Choose all that apply.
questions.explanation: replicas belongs to particular specs, not to every object.

options.text: You write spec; controllers write status

questions.explanation: That division is the reconciliation loop in one sentence.

questions.prompt: Why does a local `type: LoadBalancer` Service sit at <pending>?

options.text: There is no cloud controller to provision one

questions.explanation: Correct behaviour on kind or minikube; use NodePort or port-forward.
